scope: STRIDE, 16 cases, the five luna sweeps of 20261017T-1813-name-rule. About 101 must-finds are led on the signed model; each extracted model loses about 5 of those leads (18 unfired, 8 unaligned over five sweeps). Three references lose the lead in all five sweeps with every element aligned: 12/13 and 13/16 (elevation-of-privilege-privilege-zone-crossing) because the extracted model places the flow's source in no zone, so the crossing is undecided and the rule skips it (ADR 0039 rule 4); 12/1 (spoofing-unverified-boundary-auth) because the extraction writes the datasheet's 'fully authenticated' as the flow's authentication, which the signed model and corrections.md row 4 hold as unknown. A lead is a correlate of a match, not a match: the effect on matched must-finds is unmeasured.
